Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities on target CHEMBL1628469. Join target_dictionary for target_type and tax_id, assays for assay_chembl_id, molecule_dictionary for molecule_chembl_id, and compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
